$comment: The 2026-08-22 arena art pass. One entry per FIGURE or EFFECT; the agents that run it read
design/art/arena-art-contract.md first. Routes: 'character' = create_character v3 side view +
animate_character v3 on ONE rotation; 'image' = create_image_pixen still + animate_image.
Every strip ends as 8 square 512-px frames; the champion faces RIGHT (south-east rotation),
enemies and bosses face LEFT (south-west rotation / prompted facing left).
style_suffix: Dark fantasy pixel art, full body, clean readable silhouette

clips.idle: standing idle, feet planted and never moving: only subtle breathing, the shoulders rising and falling, cloth and loose gear swaying gently, the head still; the pose returns to the start by the last frame so it loops seamlessly
clips.cast: casting a spell: raises a hand, gathers glowing energy in the palm, thrusts the hand forward releasing it, then returns to the starting stance by the last frame; feet stay planted
clips.death: dying: staggers, drops to the knees, then collapses forward onto the ground and lies still, fully fallen by the last frame
clips.hover_idle: idle: hovering in place, rising and sinking slowly, loose parts drifting, staying on the same spot; the pose returns to the start by the last frame so it loops seamlessly

seeker.look: a lean human hooded ranger, an ordinary adult person with a plain human face, wearing a fitted dark leather jerkin and bracers, a short knife at the belt, hood up, watchful, standing in a ready fighting stance
seeker.attack: melee attack: draws the knife back, lunges forward and slashes hard across to the front, then returns fully to the starting stance by the last frame

anvil.look: a huge broad-shouldered human warrior in a riveted dark steel cuirass and banded skirt, bare heavy forearms, a thick braided beard, fists closed, feet planted wide in a brawler's stance
anvil.attack: melee attack: rears back and throws a heavy two-fisted overhand punch forward, then returns fully to the starting stance by the last frame

chorus.look: a bald human ascetic in a plain quilted tunic, arms and throat wrapped in cord, a heavy belt strung with dozens of small bone charms hanging down the thigh, calm ready stance
chorus.attack: attack: sweeps an arm forward flinging a handful of bone charms ahead like thrown blades, then returns to the starting stance by the last frame

metronome.look: a wiry human runner in a light fitted gambeson with tightly wrapped forearms and tall soft boots, hair tied back, poised on the balls of the feet in a light fighting stance
metronome.attack: attack: darts forward with a quick snapping strike of the fist, then springs back to the starting stance by the last frame

unbroken.look: a short immensely broad figure in a heavy overlapping scale coat, a plain featureless iron mask covering the whole face, thick banded greaves, arms held ready, solid planted stance
unbroken.attack: attack: drives forward with a heavy shoulder charge and a crushing forearm blow, then returns to the starting stance by the last frame

tower.look: a very tall top-heavy knight in dark plate armour, visor down, gripping an enormous two-handed maul with both gauntlets, the head of the maul resting on the ground in front of the feet, leaning onto it
tower.attack: attack: heaves the maul up over the head and slams its head down into the ground in front, then straightens back to the starting pose by the last frame

quiver.look: a lean human archer holding a tall longbow upright, a full back quiver of arrows over one shoulder, a short half-cape, hood down, sharp attentive face, ready stance
quiver.attack: attack: raises the longbow, nocks and draws the string back to the cheek, looses an arrow forward, then lowers the bow back to the starting pose by the last frame

thornwall.look: a heavy-set human warden holding a battered tower shield planted on the ground in front, coils of black bramble and barbed wire wound around the shield and both forearms, braced stance
thornwall.attack: attack: bashes forward with the tower shield, thorns flaring, then settles back to the starting stance by the last frame

oathbound.look: a tall gaunt human penitent in dark robes bound with many wound chains across the chest and arms, a strip of cloth sealed over the eyes, hands clasped together and bound, standing straight
oathbound.attack: attack: bows the head and thrusts both bound hands forward, the chains pulling taut and lashing ahead, then returns to the starting pose by the last frame

magpie.look: a grinning human scavenger in cheerfully mismatched scavenged armour, an enormous overstuffed backpack of loot with pans and trinkets hanging off it, pouches everywhere, eager crouched stance
magpie.attack: attack: swings a dented pan forward in a wide arc as a weapon, trinkets jangling, then returns to the starting stance by the last frame

bonecrawler.look: a skittering crimson bone crawler beast with many clawed legs, blood-red bone carapace, bulging musculature, fanged maw
bonecrawler.idle: idle breathing in place: body rising and sinking slightly, legs shifting weight, tail swaying gently, head facing left the whole time, staying on the same spot
bonecrawler.attack: attack: rearing back briefly then lunging forward to the LEFT with a snapping bite and raised claws, then recoiling back to the starting stance, head facing left the whole time

soul_leech.look: a hovering cyan robed leech-wraith, a hollow hood with no face and two faint glowing points, long trailing sleeves, crystal-cyan faceted hard edges, pale glowing runes on the robe, floating just above the ground
soul_leech.attack: attack: rears up, the sleeves flaring, and lashes forward with a draining grasp of cyan energy toward the front, then settles back to the hovering start by the last frame

wisp.look: a floating green forest spirit wisp, a glowing moss-green flame-like body with trailing tendrils and thorn-like branching wisps, two small glowing eyes, three-quarter side view facing left
wisp.idle: idle: hovering in place, the flame body flickering, tendrils drifting slowly, bobbing up and down gently, staying on the same spot, facing left the whole time
wisp.attack: attack: swells bright and surges forward to the LEFT lashing its tendrils, then drifts back to the starting spot, facing left the whole time

stone_sentinel.look: a hulking rust-iron stone sentinel golem, a boxy plated body of bolted modular segments, a glowing orange furnace core in the chest, heavy stone fists, short thick legs
stone_sentinel.idle: standing idle, feet planted and never moving: the furnace core pulsing, steam venting from the joints, the heavy shoulders rising and falling slowly; returns to the start by the last frame so it loops seamlessly
stone_sentinel.attack: attack: raises both fists high and slams them down hard into the ground in front, then straightens back to the starting stance by the last frame

shadeling.look: a lean indigo shadow imp with tattered torn edges, jagged ragged wisps of darkness trailing from its arms and back, long hooked claws, glowing pale eyes, hunched and ready to pounce
shadeling.idle: idle: crouched and ready, breathing, the ragged wisps of darkness flickering and drifting, claws twitching, feet planted and never moving; the pose returns to the start by the last frame so it loops seamlessly
shadeling.attack: attack: coils back then pounces forward slashing with both hooked claws, wisps of darkness trailing, then returns to the crouched starting pose by the last frame

rift_guardian.look: a tall pale armoured rift guardian, ghostly lavender-white plate armour dissolving into soft wisps at every edge, a faceless smooth helm, a long spectral glaive held upright
rift_guardian.idle: standing idle, feet planted and never moving: the wisps at the edges drifting slowly, the glaive swaying slightly, a faint pulse of light in the armour; returns to the start by the last frame so it loops seamlessly
rift_guardian.attack: attack: sweeps the spectral glaive in a wide arc forward, wisps trailing the blade, then returns to the upright starting stance by the last frame

thorn_regent.look: a towering antlered thorn regent, a tall gaunt forest king crowned in brambles with great branching antlers, bark-and-thorn armour, glowing green eyes, a long thorned staff
thorn_regent.idle: standing idle, feet planted and never moving: slow deep breathing, the brambles and vines shifting slightly, a faint green glow pulsing; returns to the start by the last frame so it loops seamlessly
thorn_regent.attack: attack: raises the thorned staff high and drives it down into the ground, thorny vines bursting forward, then draws back to the starting stance by the last frame

forge_colossus.look: a massive rust-iron forge colossus, a giant bolted-plate furnace golem with molten orange seams glowing between the plates, a smokestack on one shoulder, enormous hammer fists, short massive legs
forge_colossus.idle: standing idle, feet planted and never moving: the molten seams pulsing, smoke puffing from the stack, the great shoulders heaving slowly; returns to the start by the last frame so it loops seamlessly
forge_colossus.attack: attack: rears back and brings one enormous hammer fist crashing down in front, molten sparks flying, then hauls it back up to the starting stance by the last frame

void_reaper.look: a shrouded void reaper, a tall hooded figure of torn indigo shadow with no visible face, a great curved scythe held in both hands, frayed edges of the cloak trailing into darkness
void_reaper.attack: attack: winds the great scythe back then sweeps it in a huge arc forward, shadow trailing the blade, then returns to the hovering start by the last frame

crystal_lich.look: a floating crystal lich wreathed in faceted cyan ice shards, a tattered frost-blue robe trailing into icicles, a hollow skull face with glowing cyan eyes, clawed skeletal hands, a jagged crystal crown, hovering just above the ground
crystal_lich.idle: idle: hovering in place, rising and sinking slowly, robe drifting, crystal shards slowly orbiting the body, claws flexing; the pose returns to the start by the last frame so it loops seamlessly
crystal_lich.attack: spell attack: rears back gathering glowing crystal energy in both claws, then thrusts both hands forward hurling a burst of ice shards ahead, robe flaring, then returns to the starting pose by the last frame

lumen_angel.look: a radiant many-winged lumen angel of pale light, a tall robed figure with three pairs of feathered wings, a bright halo, a slender spear of light, hovering just above the ground
lumen_angel.attack: attack: spreads all the wings wide, raises the spear of light and thrusts it forward in a blazing lunge, then folds back to the hovering start by the last frame

spirit_matron.look: a gaunt crimson spirit matron, a tall skeletal crone trailing bone and sinew, an exposed ribcage bodice, long bone claws, a blood-red tattered shroud, hunched and menacing
spirit_matron.idle: standing idle, feet planted and never moving: slow ragged breathing, the shroud and trailing sinew swaying, the claws flexing; returns to the start by the last frame so it loops seamlessly
spirit_matron.attack: attack: rears up tall and rakes both bone claws forward in a savage double slash, sinew whipping, then sinks back to the hunched starting pose by the last frame

effects.common: a 2D game effect sprite on a transparent background, pixel art, white and pale silver light with a soft glow, NO colour, no character, no weapon, no text

strike.look: a single bright crescent slash arc of energy sweeping diagonally from upper left to lower right, a white-hot core with a pale glow and a few sparks
strike.action: the slash arc sweeps quickly from upper left to lower right, flares bright white at the peak with sparks flying, then thins and fades out completely by the last frame

projectile.look: a bright bolt of energy streaking horizontally from left to right with a long tapering trail behind it and a small burst at its head
projectile.action: the bolt flies fast from left to right across the frame, its trail stretching, then bursts in a small flash at the right edge and fades out completely by the last frame

aura.look: a thin glowing ring of light seen from the front, centred, with a soft inner glow and small sparkles around it
aura.action: the ring pulses: it expands outward from the centre, brightens, then dissolves into drifting sparkles and fades out completely by the last frame

trap.look: a burst of sharp glowing shards and spikes erupting upward out of the ground at the bottom of the frame, with dust and sparks
trap.action: the shards erupt upward from the ground, reach their full height in a bright flash, then crumble and fade out completely by the last frame

mark.look: a glowing circular sigil made of a ring and a crosshair with four small ticks, centred, thin bright lines
mark.action: the sigil appears, rotates a quarter turn while shrinking slightly to lock on, flashes bright once, then fades out completely by the last frame

transformation.look: an upward surge of light: rising streaks and motes of bright energy gathering into a column from the bottom of the frame to the top
transformation.action: the streaks and motes rise quickly upward, the column brightens to a peak, then disperses outward and fades out completely by the last frame

hit.look: a small sharp impact spark burst, a few bright radiating streaks from a central flash
hit.action: the impact flashes, the streaks shoot outward and shorten, then everything fades out completely by the last frame

weakhit.look: a small soft puff of pale dust with a few tiny specks, centred
weakhit.action: the puff expands slowly, thins, and fades out completely by the last frame

crit.look: a large dramatic starburst impact, many long bright radiating streaks and a big central flash with scattered sparks
crit.action: the starburst flashes huge and bright, the streaks extend outward with sparks scattering, then everything fades out completely by the last frame

death.look: a plume of pale smoke and ash with drifting embers rising from the bottom of the frame
death.action: the plume rises and spreads upward, the embers drift and wink out, then the smoke thins and fades out completely by the last frame

heal.look: a cluster of small glowing motes and tiny sparkles rising gently upward from the bottom of the frame
heal.action: the motes rise slowly upward, twinkling, then fade out completely near the top by the last frame

shield.look: a translucent glowing dome of light, a hemisphere seen from the front, centred, with a brighter rim
shield.action: the dome flashes into existence, ripples once with a wave of light across its surface, then fades out completely by the last frame

levelup.look: a tall narrow column of bright light with rays fanning out at the top and sparkles along its length
levelup.action: the column shoots up from the bottom, the rays fan out and flash at the top, then the whole column fades out completely by the last frame
